verdict.rationale: The docs describe Slate as an interactive TUI agent (sessions, hotkeys, `/commands`, inline cards) and mention a `--dangerously-skip-permissions`/`--yolo` flag for bypassing prompts, but there is no documented non-interactive/headless mode, scripting flag (e.g., a `-p`/print mode), or CI/automation usage example that would let a developer invoke Slate in scripts.
